component.name: DedupeDash
component.summary: Find and safely remove duplicate and near-duplicate files

description.p: DedupeDash finds exact duplicate files and visually similar images across a folder, then lets you remove the extras safely. Nothing is changed until you review the duplicate groups and confirm; removals move to Trash by default and can be replaced with hard links instead.

ul.li: Exact matching by size, progressive hash and SHA-256 with byte-for-byte verification
Image near-duplicate detection by perceptual hash, keeping the highest-resolution copy
Simple and Advanced scan tiers, dry-run preview, hard-link and Trash actions

description.p: First foundation: GTK 4 + libadwaita shell, exact-match engine, image near-duplicates, and safe actions.
